entries.title: Reddit Comments
entries.description: Drops the sidebar, the vote arrows and the comment toolbars from a thread.

entries.title: Wikipedia Article
entries.description: Drops the navigation column, the page tools and the footer from an article.

entries.title: YCombinator News Comments
entries.description: Drops the orange bar, the vote arrows and the reply forms from a thread.

entries.title: Medium Article
entries.description: Drops the floating bars, the share widget and the footer from a post.

entries.title: Twitter
entries.description: Drops the top bar, the profile header and the tweet action rows.

entries.title: GitHub
entries.description: Drops the app header, the repository toolbars and the footer.

entries.title: Stack Overflow
entries.description: Drops the top bar, the sidebar, the vote gutters and the answer form.

entries.title: Substack
entries.description: Drops the subscribe prompts, the top bar and the comment section from a post.

entries.title: arXiv Abstract
entries.description: Drops the site header, the download box and the submission history.

entries.title: Hide Cookie Banners
entries.description: Removes the consent dialogs the common banner tools put up, and undoes the page scroll lock they leave behind.

entries.title: Unstick Headers
entries.description: Stops sticky and floating bars from being pinned, so they are captured once at the top instead of over the text.

entries.title: Hide Share Widgets
entries.description: Removes the share, follow and newsletter boxes that sit between the paragraphs.

entries.title: Serif Reading
entries.description: A serif body face, looser lines and a narrower measure.

entries.title: Compact
entries.description: Smaller type and tighter spacing, for fitting more of a long page on a page.

entries.title: Large Print
entries.description: Larger type and heavier spacing throughout.

entries.title: Force Light Background
entries.description: Black on white, whatever the page uses - a dark page is captured as dark, and prints as a black slab.

entries.title: No Images
entries.description: Leaves the pictures out, for a smaller file and a text-only read.
